content.title: Cracker Barrel Stock Slips After Earnings. Its Logo Fiasco Lingers.
content.summary: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store  stock recovered most of its early losses Wednesday after the company reported earnings that beat expectations, but  lower-than-expected revenue.  Cracker Barrel stock was down 0.1% at 10:30 a.m. on Wednesday, after being down 8% in premarket trading.  In its previous first quarter, Cracker Barrel reported earnings of 45 cents a share on $845 million in revenue.
